no final gather is required.\n\nconstexpr size_t NB = 256;  // distribution / panel block size\nconstexpr int TS = 32;      // CUDA tile size\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); Each element accumulates in increasing t order,\n// matching the summation order of the original sequential algorithm.\n__global__ void gemmNTKernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t n, size_t rowStart,\n                             size_t m, size_t colStart, size_t w, size_t pcol,\n                             size_t kw) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[TS][TS + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    const size_t r = rowStart + blockIdx.y * TS + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = colStart + blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t yr = colStart + blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.y;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < kw; t0 += TS) {\n        const size_t t = t0 + threadIdx.x;\n        Xs[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] =\n            (r < rowStart + m && t < kw) ? A[r * n + pcol + t] : 0.0;\n        Ys[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] =\n            (yr < colStart + w && t < kw) ? A[yr * n + pcol + t] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TS; ++tt) {\n            acc += Xs[threadIdx.y][tt] * Ys[threadIdx.x][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (r < rowStart + m && c < colStart + w) {\n        A[r * n + c] -= acc;\n    }\n}\n\n// A[r][c] = sum_k B[r][k] * B[k][c]^T (+ n on the diagonal); computes the\n// symmetric positive definite input matrix A = B * B^T + n * I on the GPU.\n__global__ void genMatKernel(double* __restrict__ A,\n                             const double* __restrict__ B, size_t n) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[TS][TS + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    const size_t r = blockIdx.y * TS + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t yr = blockIdx.x * (size_t)TS + threadIdx.y;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < n; t0 += TS) {\n        const size_t t = t0 + threadIdx.x;\n        Xs[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (r < n && t < n) ? B[r * n + t] : 0.0;\n        Ys[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (yr < n && t < n) ? B[yr * n + t] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TS; ++tt) {\n            acc += Xs[threadIdx.y][tt] * Ys[threadIdx.x][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (r < n && c < n) {\n        A[r * n + c] = acc + (r == c ? (double)n : 0.0);\n    }\n}\n\n// Solve B := B * L^{-T} for one TS-wide sub-panel: rows [rowStart, rowStart+m)\n// of columns [k0+s, k0+s+sw), against the already-factored TS x TS diagonal\n// sub-block at (k0+s, k0+s). One thread per row; the diagonal sub-block is\n// padded to the identity beyond sw so the solve can stay fully unrolled.\n__global__ void trsmPanelKernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t n, size_t k0,\n                                size_t s, size_t sw, size_t rowStart,\n                                size_t m) {\n    __shared__ double Ls[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < TS * TS; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int rr = idx / TS;\n        const int cc = idx % TS;\n        double v = (rr == cc) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n        if (rr < (int)sw && cc < (int)sw && cc <= rr) {\n            v = A[(k0 + s + rr) * n + (k0 + s + cc)];\n        }\n        Ls[rr][cc] = v;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const size_t r = rowStart + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= rowStart + m) return;\n\n    double b[TS];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < TS; ++j) {\n        b[j] = (j < (int)sw) ? A[r * n + k0 + s + j] : 0.0;\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < TS; ++j) {\n        double v = b[j];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int t = 0; t < TS; ++t) {\n            if (t < j) v -= b[t] * Ls[j][t];\n        }\n        b[j] = v / Ls[j][j];\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < TS; ++j) {\n        if (j < (int)sw) A[r * n + k0 + s + j] = b[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of the nb x nb diagonal block on the CPU (OpenMP over\n// the rows of each column). Zeroes the upper triangle of the block. Returns\n// the failing column index if the block is not positive definite, else -1.\nstatic long long potrfHost(double* D, const size_t nb) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += D[j * nb + k] * D[j * nb + k];\n        }\n        const double val = D[j * nb + j] - sum;\n        if (val <= 0.0) {\n            return (long long)j;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(val);\n        D[j * nb + j] = d;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n            double s = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                s += D[i * nb + k] * D[j * nb + k];\n            }\n            D[i * nb + j] = (D[i * nb + j] - s) / d;\n        }\n        for (size_t c = j + 1; c < nb; ++c) {\n            D[j * nb + c] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// Distributed blocked right-looking Cholesky on the device matrix d_A.\n// h_panel (n*NB) and h_diag (NB*NB) are pinned host staging buffers.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(double* d_A, const size_t n, const int rank,\n                           const int nranks, double* h_panel, double* h_diag) {\n    const size_t nblocks = (n + NB - 1) / NB;\n    const size_t dbl = sizeof(double);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < nblocks; ++k) {\n        const size_t k0 = k * NB;\n        const size_t kb = std::min(NB, n - k0);\n        const size_t mrows = n - (k0 + kb);  // panel rows below the diag block\n        const int owner = (int)(k % (size_t)nranks);\n        long long status = -1;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            // Factor the diagonal block on the CPU (OpenMP).\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(h_diag, kb * dbl, d_A + k0 * n + k0,\n                                    n * dbl, kb * dbl, kb,\n                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            status = potrfHost(h_diag, kb);\n            if (status >= 0) {\n                status += (long long)k0;  // global failing diagonal index\n            } else {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_A + k0 * n + k0, n * dbl, h_diag,\n                                        kb * dbl, kb * dbl, kb,\n                                        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                // Blocked TRSM of the panel below the diagonal block.\n                if (mrows > 0) {\n                    for (size_t s = 0; s < kb; s += TS) {\n                        const size_t sw = std::min((size_t)TS, kb - s);\n                        const int bt = 128;\n                        trsmPanelKernel<<<(unsigned)((mrows + bt - 1) / bt),\n                                          bt>>>(d_A, n, k0, s, sw, k0 + kb,\n                                                mrows);\n                        if (s + sw < kb) {\n                            dim3 grid((unsigned)((kb - s - sw + TS - 1) / TS),\n                                      (unsigned)((mrows + TS - 1) / TS));\n                            gemmNTKernel<<<grid, dim3(TS, TS)>>>(\n                                d_A, n, k0 + kb, mrows, k0 + s + sw,\n                                kb - s - sw, k0 + s, sw);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                // Stage the finished panel (diag block + rows below) for the\n                // broadcast; the copy also synchronizes the kernels above.\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(h_panel, kb * dbl, d_A + k0 * n + k0,\n                                        n * dbl, kb * dbl, n - k0,\n                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (status >= 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal \"\n                       \"element %lld\\n\", status);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(h_panel, (int)((n - k0) * kb), MPI_DOUBLE, owner,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (rank != owner) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_A + k0 * n + k0, n * dbl, h_panel,\n                                    kb * dbl, kb * dbl, n - k0,\n                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        // Trailing update of the block columns owned by this rank.\n        for (size_t j = k + 1; j < nblocks; ++j) {\n            if ((int)(j % (size_t)nranks) != rank) continue;\n            const size_t c0 = j * NB;\n            const size_t w = std::min(NB, n - c0);\n            const size_t m = n - c0;\n            dim3 grid((unsigned)((w + TS - 1) / TS),\n                      (unsigned)((m + TS - 1) / TS));\n            gemmNTKernel<<<grid, dim3(TS, TS)>>>(d_A, n, c0, m, c0, w, k0, kb);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix A = B * B^T + n * I directly\n// on the GPU. B is drawn from the same deterministic rand_r(42) stream as the\n// original sequential code, so the input matrix is reproducible on all ranks.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(double* d_A, const size_t n) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* d_B = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_B, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_B, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    dim3 grid((unsigned)((n + TS - 1) / TS), (unsigned)((n + TS - 1) / TS));\n    genMatKernel<<<grid, dim3(TS, TS)>>>(d_A, d_B, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaFree(d_B));\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n\n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n\n    // Compute L * L^T (OpenMP)\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static) reduction(max : maxError, relError)\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n\n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n\n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n\n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// Simple Cholesky decomposition (sequential, unblocked algorithm)\n// Decomposes positive definite matrix A into L * L^T where L is lower triangular\n\nbool choleskyDecomposition(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // A is stored in row-major order\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j <= i; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            \n            if (i == j) {\n                // Diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[j * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                const double val = A[j * n + j] - sum;\n                if (val <= 0.0) {\n                    // Matrix is not positive definite\n                    printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal element %zu\\n\", j);\n                    return false;\n                }\n                A[j * n + j] = sqrt(val);\n            } else {\n                // Off-diagonal element\n                for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                    sum += A[i * n + k] * A[j * n + k];\n                }\n                A[i * n + j] = (A[i * n + j] - sum) / A[j * n + j];\n            }\n        }\n        \n        // Zero out upper triangular part\n        for (size_t j = i + 1; j < n; ++j) {\n            A[i * n + j] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(std::vector<double>& A, const size_t n) {\n    // Method: Create A = B * B^T where B is random\n    // This guarantees A is positive semi-definite\n    // Then add identity to make it strictly positive definite\n    \n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n    \n    // Generate random matrix B\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n    \n    // Compute A = B * B^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += B[i * n + k] * B[j * n + k];\n            }\n            A[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Add diagonal dominance to ensure positive definiteness\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        A[i * n + i] += n;\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateCholesky(const std::vector<double>& L, const std::vector<double>& A_orig, const size_t n) {\n    // Validate by computing L * L^T and comparing with original matrix\n    \n    std::vector<double> reconstructed(n * n);\n    \n    // Compute L * L^T\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; ++i) {\n        for (size_t j = 0; j < n; ++j) {\n            double sum = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < n; ++k) {\n                sum += L[i * n + k] * L[j * n + k];\n            }\n            reconstructed[i * n + j] = sum;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Compare with original\n    double maxError = 0.0;\n    double relError = 0.0;\n    \n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        const double error = fabs(reconstructed[i] - A_orig[i]);\n        maxError = std::max(maxError, error);\n        \n        const double rel = error / (fabs(A_orig[i]) + 1e-10);\n        relError = std::max(relError, rel);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Max absolute error: %.10e\\n\", maxError);\n    printf(\"Max relative error: %.10e\\n\", relError);\n    \n    // Check if error is within tolerance\n    if (relError > 1e-6) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: relative error too large\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -n <num>     Matrix size (default: 512)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t n = 512;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line arguments\n    for (int i = 1; i < argc; ++i) {\n        if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-n\") == 0 && i + 1 < argc) {\n            n = atoi(argv[++i]);\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-v\") == 0) {\n            validate = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-r\") == 0) {\n            printResults = true;\n        } else if (strcmp(argv[i], \"-h\") == 0) {\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Unknown option: %s\\n\", argv[i]);\n            printUsage(argv[0]);\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Cholesky Decomposition Benchmark\\n\");\n    printf(\"Matrix size: %zu x %zu\\n\", n, n);\n    printf(\"Validation: %s\\n\", validate ? \"enabled\" : \"disabled\");\n    \n    // Allocate matrix\n    std::vector<double> A(n * n);\n    std::vector<double> A_orig;\n    \n    // Generate positive definite matrix\n    printf(\"Generating positive definite matrix...\\n\");\n    generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(A, n);\n    \n    if (validate) {\n        A_orig = A; // Save original for validation\n    }\n    \n    // Perform Cholesky decomposition\n    printf(\"Computing Cholesky decomposition...\\n\");\n    auto start = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    \n    bool success = choleskyDecomposition(A, n);\n    \n    auto end = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    auto duration = std::chrono::duration_cast<std::chrono::milliseconds>(end - start);\n    \n    if (!success) {\n        printf(\"Cholesky decomposition failed\\n\");\n        return 1;\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Computation time: %ld ms\\n\", duration.count());\n    \n    // Calculate GFLOPS (approximately n³/3 operations for Cholesky)\n    double ops = (double)n * n * n / 3.0;\n    double gflops = ops / (duration.count() / 1000.0) / 1e9;\n    printf(\"Performance: %.3f GFLOPS\\n\", gflops);\n    \n    // Print results for external validation\n    if (printResults) {\n        print_results(A, \"CholeskyL\");\n    }\n    \n    // Validation\n    if (validate) {\n        printf(\"Validating result...\\n\");\n        bool valid = validateCholesky(A, A_orig, n);\n        \n        if (valid) {\n            printf(\"Validation: PASSED\\n\");\n            return 0;\n        } else {\n            printf(\"Validation: FAILED\\n\");\n            return 1;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    return 0;\n}\n","userModified":false}}

no final gather is required.\n\nconstexpr size_t NB = 256;  // distribution / panel block size\nconstexpr int TS = 32;      // CUDA tile size\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call); Each element accumulates in increasing t order,\n// matching the summation order of the original sequential algorithm.\n__global__ void gemmNTKernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t n, size_t rowStart,\n                             size_t m, size_t colStart, size_t w, size_t pcol,\n                             size_t kw) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[TS][TS + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    const size_t r = rowStart + blockIdx.y * TS + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = colStart + blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t yr = colStart + blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.y;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < kw; t0 += TS) {\n        const size_t t = t0 + threadIdx.x;\n        Xs[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] =\n            (r < rowStart + m && t < kw) ? B[r * n + t] : 0.0;\n        Ys[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (yr < n && t < n) ? B[yr * n + t] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TS; ++tt) {\n            acc += Xs[threadIdx.y][tt] * Ys[threadIdx.x][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (r < n && c < n) {\n        A[r * n + c] = acc + (r == c ? One thread per row; the diagonal sub-block is\n// padded to the identity beyond sw so the solve can stay fully unrolled.\n__global__ void trsmPanelKernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t n, size_t k0,\n                                size_t s, size_t sw, size_t rowStart,\n                                size_t m) {\n    __shared__ double Ls[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    for (int idx = threadIdx.x; idx < TS * TS; idx += blockDim.x) {\n        const int rr = idx / TS;\n        const int cc = idx % TS;\n        double v = (rr == cc) ? 1.0 : 0.0;\n        if (rr < (int)sw && cc < (int)sw && cc <= rr) {\n            v = A[(k0 + s + rr) * n + (k0 + s + cc)];\n        }\n        Ls[rr][cc] = v;\n    }\n    __syncthreads();\n\n    const size_t r = rowStart + blockIdx.x * blockDim.x + threadIdx.x;\n    if (r >= rowStart + m) return;\n\n    double b[TS];\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < TS; ++j) {\n        b[j] = (j < (int)sw) ? A[r * n + k0 + s + j] : 0.0;\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < TS; ++j) {\n        double v = b[j];\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int t = 0; t < TS; ++t) {\n            if (t < j) v -= b[t] * Ls[j][t];\n        }\n        b[j] = v / Ls[j][j];\n    }\n#pragma unroll\n    for (int j = 0; j < TS; ++j) {\n        if (j < (int)sw) A[r * n + k0 + s + j] = b[j];\n    }\n}\n\n// Unblocked Cholesky of the nb x nb diagonal block on the CPU (OpenMP over\n// the rows of each column). Zeroes the upper triangle of the block. Returns\n// the failing column index if the block is not positive definite, else -1.\nstatic long long potrfHost(double* D, const size_t nb) {\n    for (size_t j = 0; j < nb; ++j) {\n        double sum = 0.0;\n        for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n            sum += D[j * nb + k] * D[j * nb + k];\n        }\n        const double val = D[j * nb + j] - sum;\n        if (val <= 0.0) {\n            return (long long)j;\n        }\n        const double d = sqrt(val);\n        D[j * nb + j] = d;\n#pragma omp parallel for schedule(static)\n        for (size_t i = j + 1; i < nb; ++i) {\n            double s = 0.0;\n            for (size_t k = 0; k < j; ++k) {\n                s += D[i * nb + k] * D[j * nb + k];\n            }\n            D[i * nb + j] = (D[i * nb + j] - s) / d;\n        }\n        for (size_t c = j + 1; c < nb; ++c) {\n            D[j * nb + c] = 0.0;\n        }\n    }\n    return -1;\n}\n\n// Distributed blocked right-looking Cholesky on the device matrix d_A.\n// h_panel (n*NB) and h_diag (NB*NB) are pinned host staging buffers.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(double* d_A, const size_t n, const int rank,\n                           const int nranks, double* h_panel, double* h_diag) {\n    const size_t nblocks = (n + NB - 1) / NB;\n    const size_t dbl = sizeof(double);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; the copy also synchronizes the kernels above.\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(h_panel, kb * dbl, d_A + k0 * n + k0,\n                                        n * dbl, kb * dbl, n - k0,\n                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (status >= 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal \"\n                       \"element %lld\\n\", status);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(h_panel, (int)((n - k0) * kb), MPI_DOUBLE, owner,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (rank != owner) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_A + k0 * n + k0, n * dbl, h_panel,\n                                    kb * dbl, kb * dbl, n - k0,\n                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        // Trailing update of the block columns owned by this rank.\n        for (size_t j = k + 1; j < nblocks; ++j) {\n            if ((int)(j % (size_t)nranks) != rank) continue;\n            const size_t c0 = j * NB;\n            const size_t w = std::min(NB, n - c0);\n            const size_t m = n - c0;\n            dim3 grid((unsigned)((w + TS - 1) / TS),\n                      (unsigned)((m + TS - 1) / TS));\n            gemmNTKernel<<<grid, dim3(TS, TS)>>>(d_A, n, c0, m, c0, w, k0, kb);\n        }\n        CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n    }\n\n    return true;\n}\n\n// Generate a symmetric positive definite matrix A = B * B^T + n * I directly\n// on the GPU. B is drawn from the same deterministic rand_r(42) stream as the\n// original sequential code, so the input matrix is reproducible on all ranks.\nvoid generatePositiveDefiniteMatrix(double* d_A, const size_t n) {\n    std::vector<double> B(n * n);\n    unsigned int seed = 42;\n\n    for (size_t i = 0; i < n * n; ++i) {\n        B[i] = (rand_r(&seed) / (double)RAND_MAX) - 0.5;\n    }\n\n    double* d_B = nullptr;\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMalloc(&d_B, n * n * sizeof(double)));\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy(d_B, B.data(), n * n * sizeof(double),\n                          cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n\n    dim3 grid((unsigned)((n + TS - 1) / TS), (unsigned)((n + TS - 1) / TS));\n    genMatKernel<<<grid, dim3(TS, TS)>>>(d_A, d_B, n);\n    CUDA_CHECK(cudaDeviceSynchronize());\n I'll add lookahead so the next panel is factored and broadcast via MPI_Ibcast early, overlapping it with trailing updates.\n\n","signature":""}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":624,"cache_read_input_tokens":51371,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":624},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"08d972d9-b46c-4a65-9b33-e275ae0fdee7","uuid":"88fd053a-5248-4359-84d8-02065ec80a8d","timestamp":"2026-09-14T03:31:28.589Z","request_id":"req_011Cf2dBWSQEhKufCUGSoYH2","narration_block_indexes":[0]}
{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-fable-5","id":"msg_011Cf2dBXhJp3tyZMfkSzcxQ","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_011cJAP6fifxPDMtPeHwPKTA","name":"Edit","input":{"replace_all":false,"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/cholesky_claude-fable-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r5/cholesky/cholesky.cpp","old_string":"// Distributed blocked right-looking Cholesky on the device matrix d_A.\n// h_panel (n*NB) and h_diag (NB*NB) are pinned host staging buffers.\nbool choleskyDecomposition(double* d_A, const size_t n, const int rank,\n                           const int nranks, double* h_panel, double* h_diag) {\n    const size_t nblocks = (n + NB - 1) / NB;\n    const size_t dbl = sizeof(double);\n\n    for (size_t k = 0; k < nblocks; ++k) {\n        const size_t k0 = k * NB;\n        const size_t kb = std::min(NB, n - k0);\n        const size_t mrows = n - (k0 + kb);  // panel rows below the diag block\n        const int owner = (int)(k % (size_t)nranks);\n        long long status = -1;\n\n        if (rank == owner) {\n            // Factor the diagonal block on the CPU (OpenMP).\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(h_diag, kb * dbl, d_A + k0 * n + k0,\n                                    n * dbl, kb * dbl, kb,\n                                    cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            status = potrfHost(h_diag, kb);\n            if (status >= 0) {\n                status += (long long)k0;  // global failing diagonal index\n            } else {\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_A + k0 * n + k0, n * dbl, h_diag,\n                                        kb * dbl, kb * dbl, kb,\n                                        cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n                // Blocked TRSM of the panel below the diagonal block.\n                if (mrows > 0) {\n                    for (size_t s = 0; s < kb; s += TS) {\n                        const size_t sw = std::min((size_t)TS, kb - s);\n                        const int bt = 128;\n                        trsmPanelKernel<<<(unsigned)((mrows + bt - 1) / bt),\n                                          bt>>>(d_A, n, k0, s, sw, k0 + kb,\n                                                mrows);\n                        if (s + sw < kb) {\n                            dim3 grid((unsigned)((kb - s - sw + TS - 1) / TS),\n                                      (unsigned)((mrows + TS - 1) / TS));\n                            gemmNTKernel<<<grid, dim3(TS, TS)>>>(\n                                d_A, n, k0 + kb, mrows, k0 + s + sw,\n                                kb - s - sw, k0 + s, sw);\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                // Stage the finished panel (diag block + rows below) for the\n                // broadcast; the copy also synchronizes the kernels above.\n                CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(h_panel, kb * dbl, d_A + k0 * n + k0,\n                                        n * dbl, kb * dbl, n - k0,\n                                        cudaMemcpyDeviceToHost));\n            }\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(&status, 1, MPI_LONG_LONG, owner, MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (status >= 0) {\n            if (rank == 0) {\n                printf(\"Error: Matrix is not positive definite at diagonal \"\n                       \"element %lld\\n\", status);\n            }\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        MPI_Bcast(h_panel, (int)((n - k0) * kb), MPI_DOUBLE, owner,\n                  MPI_COMM_WORLD);\n        if (rank != owner) {\n            CUDA_CHECK(cudaMemcpy2D(d_A + k0 * n + k0, n * dbl, h_panel,\n                                    kb * dbl, kb * dbl, n - k0,\n                                    cudaMemcpyHostToDevice));\n        }\n\n        // Trailing update of the block columns owned by this rank.\n        for (size_t j = k + 1; Block columns of width NB are distributed cyclically over the MPI ranks;\n//   each rank drives one GPU (selected by local rank on the node).\n// - The owner of the current block column factors the NB x NB diagonal block\n//   on the CPU with OpenMP, solves the panel below it with a CUDA TRSM kernel,\n//   and broadcasts the finished panel to all ranks.\n// - Every rank then applies the trailing SYRK/GEMM update to the block columns\n//   it owns using a tiled CUDA kernel, so the O(n^3) work is split across all\n//   GPUs in the cluster.\n// - Since every panel is broadcast, each rank ends up with the complete factor\n//   L on its GPU; no final gather is required.\n\nconstexpr size_t NB = 256;  // distribution / panel block size\nconstexpr int TS = 32;      // CUDA tile size\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                     \\\n    do {                                                                     \\\n        cudaError_t err_ = (call);                                           \\\n        if (err_ != cudaSuccess) {                                           \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\",                      \\\n                    cudaGetErrorString(err_), __FILE__, __LINE__);           \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                    \\\n        }                                                                    \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// A[r][c] -= sum_t A[r][pcol+t] * A[c][pcol+t]\n// for r in [rowStart, rowStart+m), c in [colStart, colStart+w), t in [0, kw).\n// Used both for the trailing update (panel * panel^T) and for the blocked\n// TRSM update inside a panel. Each element accumulates in increasing t order,\n// matching the summation order of the original sequential algorithm.\n__global__ void gemmNTKernel(double* __restrict__ A, size_t n, size_t rowStart,\n                             size_t m, size_t colStart, size_t w, size_t pcol,\n                             size_t kw) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[TS][TS + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    const size_t r = rowStart + blockIdx.y * TS + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = colStart + blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t yr = colStart + blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.y;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < kw; t0 += TS) {\n        const size_t t = t0 + threadIdx.x;\n        Xs[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] =\n            (r < rowStart + m && t < kw) ? A[r * n + pcol + t] : 0.0;\n        Ys[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] =\n            (yr < colStart + w && t < kw) ? A[yr * n + pcol + t] : 0.0;\n        __syncthreads();\n#pragma unroll\n        for (int tt = 0; tt < TS; ++tt) {\n            acc += Xs[threadIdx.y][tt] * Ys[threadIdx.x][tt];\n        }\n        __syncthreads();\n    }\n    if (r < rowStart + m && c < colStart + w) {\n        A[r * n + c] -= acc;\n    }\n}\n\n// A[r][c] = sum_k B[r][k] * B[k][c]^T (+ n on the diagonal); computes the\n// symmetric positive definite input matrix A = B * B^T + n * I on the GPU.\n__global__ void genMatKernel(double* __restrict__ A,\n                             const double* __restrict__ B, size_t n) {\n    __shared__ double Xs[TS][TS + 1];\n    __shared__ double Ys[TS][TS + 1];\n\n    const size_t r = blockIdx.y * TS + threadIdx.y;\n    const size_t c = blockIdx.x * TS + threadIdx.x;\n    const size_t yr = blockIdx.x * (size_t)TS + threadIdx.y;\n\n    double acc = 0.0;\n    for (size_t t0 = 0; t0 < n; t0 += TS) {\n        const size_t t = t0 + threadIdx.x;\n        Xs[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (r < n && t < n) ? B[r * n + t] : 0.0;\n        Ys[threadIdx.y][threadIdx.x] = (yr < n && t < n) ? The Cholesky benchmark is now a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA implementation, validated correct and scaling across all 4 GPUs.\n\n## Design\n\n`cholesky/cholesky.cpp` now implements a blocked right-looking Cholesky with one-step lookahead:\n\n- **MPI**: block columns (width 256) are distributed cyclically over ranks; each rank drives one GPU (chosen by per-node local rank, so it maps naturally onto a multi-GPU cluster). Finished panels are broadcast to all ranks, so every GPU ends up with the complete factor and no final gather is needed.\n- **CUDA**: the O(n³) trailing SYRK/GEMM updates and the panel TRSM run as tiled double-precision kernels on each rank's GPU; matrix generation (B·Bᵀ) also runs on the GPU.\n- **OpenMP**: the diagonal-block POTRF runs on the CPU inside the timed loop (with a capped team size so oversubscribed launches don't thrash), and validation/post-processing loops are parallelized.\n- **Lookahead**: the owner of block column k+1 updates and factors its panel first and broadcasts it via `MPI_Ibcast` while all ranks apply the bulk trailing update for step k, hiding panel factorization and communication off the critical path — this alone took 4-GPU throughput from ~780 to ~1200 GFLOPS at n=16384.\n\n`CMakeLists.txt` compiles the existing `cholesky.cpp` as CUDA (arch 86), links `MPI::MPI_CXX` and `OpenMP::OpenMP_CXX`, and keeps the executable name `cholesky`. No new files or external dependencies (only the CUDA runtime, MPI, and OpenMP already implied by the parallelization).\n\n## Results\n\n| Configuration | Time | GFLOPS |\n|---|---|---|\n| 1 rank, n=16384 | 2877 ms | 510 (≈ FP64 peak of one RTX 3090) |\n| 4 ranks, n=16384 | 1215 ms | 1207 (2.4×) |\n| 4 ranks, n=24576 | 3258 ms | 1519 (~68% of 4-GPU peak) |\n\nCorrectness: `-v` validation passes at every configuration tested, including edge cases (n=100 < block size, odd sizes 513/777/1000/1500, 2 and 3 ranks). Semantics are preserved — same `rand_r(42)` input matrix, same output format, same positive-definiteness error path — and the `-r` results (sum, samples, hash) are bit-identical between 1 and 4 ranks, since every element accumulates its updates in the same order regardless of the distribution.\n\nOne note: the parallel code accumulates dot products in the same k-order as the original but subtracts updates incrementally, so results can differ from the sequential build in the last bits of rounding; the relative error against L·Lᵀ stays at ~1e-11, well within the benchmark's 1e-6 tolerance."}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":714,"cache_read_input_tokens":67972,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":714},"output_tokens":3,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"08d972d9-b46c-4a65-9b33-e275ae0fdee7","uuid":"19e215ca-3d5e-40d7-a48e-d2d75ffe76af","timestamp":"2026-09-14T03:40:53.755Z","request_id":"req_011Cf2dxJQrLkK86bfS6K21A"}
